messages:
incident-bot: RWINF-504 resolved; creating PIR follow-up thread per runbook. Please nominate a facilitator and preferred 30–60m slots. Add attendees who must join. :white_check_mark:

maya: I can facilitate if folks are ok with that. Available Wed 10–11am PT or Thu 2–3pm PT.

kevin: @maya thanks — either works, prefer Thu. Thu 2pm PT is good for me.

sarah: Thu 2pm PT also works. Can we make it 45m? Payments team only needs ~20m of sync.

dinesh: Happy to be backup facilitator or take notes. If maya is lead, I can shadow and pick up action tracking.

samira: I will draft a 1-page preread (timeline + customer impact + telemetry) and an action-item template. Will share a gist by EOD.

maya: sounds good. @samira can you include the short prompt set we ran that showed the regression? helps with quality regression checks.

samira: yep — will attach sample prompts and perf snapshots.

kevin: heads-up: need @support and @sales on the invite for impacted accounts (they requested a readout). Who owns invites?

maya: I can send the calendar invite once slot is confirmed. Please add any extra attendees in thread.

incident-bot: Quick poll options (pick all that work):
 - Option A: Wed 10:00 PT (30m)
 - Option B: Wed 10:30 PT (45m)
 - Option C: Thu 14:00 PT (45m)
 - Option D: Thu 15:00 PT (30m)

kevin: C only.

sarah: C + D if it helps others. prefer C.

dinesh: C is fine for me.

samira: C works. will have preread ready 24h before.

maya: OK looks like Thu 14:00 PT (Option C) is the consensus. I'll book 45m and include these agenda items: 1) brief timeline, 2) customer impact, 3) root cause & mitigations, 4) actions and owners.

maya: facilitator: maya; backup facilitator/note-taker: dinesh; preread owner: samira; invite owner: maya.

kevin: +1. Can we add a short pre-read requirement: read the timeline and top 3 errors so we can jump to RCA?

samira: noted — preread will have TL;DR and the top 3 error traces.

maya: quick FYI for invite text: 'PIR for RWINF-504 — please read preread before the meeting. We'll keep it focused on mitigation and action owners.' I'll include link to incident doc and logs.

maya: pinging @support and @sales in case they need to add attendee emails.

kevin: :thumbsup: I'll block my calendar.

incident-bot: calendar created: Thu 2143659160 (this is a placeholder id) — 45m — invite sent to participants list.

maya: thanks all. action items before meeting:
 - samira: preread + sample prompts (due 24h before)
 - dinesh: draft action tracking spreadsheet + playbook links (due EOD)
 - kevin: compile list of affected customers and support notes (due 24h before)

dinesh: I'll create the tracking sheet and add a column for severity/ETA.

maya: Great. If anyone can't make it, please flag now so we can loop in a delegate. Otherwise see you Thu 14:00 PT. :calendar:
